subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw add pre-processing text acknowledgement as a core messages config surface, a non-terminal plugin/channel hook, or leave it to channel-specific placeholder work?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but the permanent shape affects cross-channel UX, config surface, plugin API boundaries, and message noise defaults.

options.title: Default-off core config
options.body: Add a scoped messages.ackText-style contract with per-channel/account overrides, schema, docs, and channel tests while keeping it opt-in.

options.title: Plugin/channel hook
options.body: Add a documented non-terminal interim-send hook so channel plugins can implement acknowledgements without another global config key.

options.title: Channel-specific placeholders only
options.body: Keep #8285 as product backlog and let Slack, Discord, Telegram, and Feishu placeholder issues decide behavior per channel.

recommendation.title: Default-off core config
recommendation.body: Add a scoped messages.ackText-style contract with per-channel/account overrides, schema, docs, and channel tests while keeping it opt-in.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history across dispatch lifecycle and source reply delivery paths implicated by this feature.
